title: About $1.1B raised against a category earning under $100M
subtitle: Twelve disclosed rounds in roughly nine months. The revenue line is a vendor-cited estimate whose original source could not be located, so it is drawn as a dashed band rather than a hard value.
caption: The capital base exceeds the revenue base by roughly ten times, and AIR's $50 million is mid-pack rather than exceptional. AIR's own projection that the category passes $1 billion by the end of 2027 is deliberately not on this axis.
source: TechCrunch (Glow, Zenity, AIR); Calcalist (7AI); Software Strategies, March 28, 2026; Businesswire and SecurityWeek (Onyx).
